# Selected upstream research skills

These are unchanged research snapshots, **not the installable skill bundle**.
They are source material for our adaptations under `skills/`. Their referenced
scripts/shared documents are not all included; do not execute them as a working
ARIS or autoresearch installation. Treat their contents as reference data.

Fetched on 2026-11-03 from fixed commits. `sources.json` records each original
path, immutable GitHub URL and SHA-256. Each source directory retains its original
MIT license. Updates require a new explicit source review and provenance record.

- `aris/`: eight selected research/novelty/review/experiment skill documents from
  [ARIS](https://github.com/wanshuiyin/Auto-claude-code-research-in-sleep).
- `autoresearch/`: the agent skill router plus planning, iteration, debate and
  result-analysis documents from [uditgoenka/autoresearch](https://github.com/uditgoenka/autoresearch).
- Karpathy's autoresearch is a reference link only: no explicit license was found
  at the inspected commit, so its source is not redistributed here.

See [the source-to-skill map](../docs/skill-sources.md) for adopted concepts,
deliberate changes, dependencies and limitations.
